# title
<!-- @starci/seperator -->
Backend foundations: Frameworks, request lifecycle, configuration and logging
<!-- @starci/seperator -->
# description
<!-- @starci/seperator -->
Grasp the foundational concepts of a production backend: the role of a framework and inversion of control, the request/response lifecycle, multi-environment configuration, and structured logging. NestJS is used as the illustrating example, but the knowledge applies to any language.
<!-- @starci/seperator -->
